lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 5 ghar 3 ||
lines.translation: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man har siu laagee preet ||
lines.translation: My mind is in love with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g har har japat niramal saachee reet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; my lifestyle is pure and true. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਘਣੀ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: darasan kee piaas ghanee chitavat anik prakaar ||
lines.translation: I have such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; I think of him in so many ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: karahu anugrahu paarabraham har kirapaa dhaar muraar ||1||
lines.translation: So be Merciful, O Supreme Lord; shower Your Mercy upon me, O Lord, Destroyer of pride. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਆਇਆ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man paradesee aaiaa milio saadh kai sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: My stranger soul has come to join the Saadh Sangat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕਉ ਚਾਹਤਾ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis vakhar kau chaahataa so paaio naamahi ra(n)g ||2||
lines.translation: That commodity, which I longed for, I have found in the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jete maaiaa ra(n)g ras binas jaahi khin maahi ||
lines.translation: There are so many pleasures and delights of Maya, but they pass away in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੁੰਚਹਿ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat rate tere naam siu sukh bhu(n)chahi sabh thaai ||3||
lines.translation: Your devotees are imbued with Your Name; they enjoy peace everywhere. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਚਲਤਉ ਪੇਖੀਐ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jag chalatau pekheeai nihachal har ko naau ||
lines.translation: The entire world is seen to be passing away; only the Lord's Name is lasting and stable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਈ ਸਾਧ ਸਿਉ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kar mitraaee saadh siu nihachal paavahi thaau ||4||
lines.translation: So make friends with the Holy Saints, so that you may obtain a lasting place of rest. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪਾ ਕੋਊ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: meet saajan sut ba(n)dhapaa kooo hot na saath ||
lines.translation: Friends, acquaintances, children and relatives - none of these shall be your companion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਵਾਹੂ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਦੀਨਾ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਥ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: ek nivaahoo raam naam deenaa kaa prabh naath ||5||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name alone shall go with you; God is the Master of the meek. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਭਏ ਲਗਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਤੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal bohith bhae lag saagar tario teh ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Lotus Feet are the Boat; attached to Them, you shall cross over the world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੇਟਿਓ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: bhetio pooraa satiguroo saachaa prabh siu neh ||6||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, I embrace True Love for God. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਜਾਚਨਾ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadh tere kee jaachanaa visar na saas giraas ||
lines.translation: The prayer of Your Holy Saints is, "May I never forget You, for even one breath or morsel of food."

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਾਰਜ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so bhalaa terai bhaanai kaaraj raas ||7||
lines.translation: Whatever is pleasing to Your Will is good; by Your Sweet Will, my affairs are adjusted. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਿਲੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar preetam mile upaje mahaa ana(n)d ||
lines.translation: I have met my Beloved, the Ocean of Peace, and Supreme Bliss has welled up within me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਮਿਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਟੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak sabh dukh mite prabh bhete paramaana(n)d ||8||1||2||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, all my pains have been eradicated, meeting with God, the Lord of Supreme Bliss. ||8||1||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਬਿਰਹੜੇ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਛੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਜਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 birahaRe ghar 4 chha(n)taa kee jat ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Birharray ~ Songs Of Separation, To Be Sung In The Tune Of The Chhants. Fourth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham prabh simareeai piaare darasan kau bal jaau ||1||
lines.translation: Remember the Supreme Lord God, O Beloved, and make yourself a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖ ਬੀਸਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਤਜਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis simarat dukh beesarahi piaare so kiu tajanaa jaai ||2||
lines.translation: Remembering Him, sorrows are forgotten, O Beloved; how can one forsake Him? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਵੇਚੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ihu tan vechee sa(n)t pahi piaare preetam dei milaai ||3||
lines.translation: I would sell this body to the Saint, O Beloved, if he would lead me to my Dear Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਫੀਕੇ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sukh seegaar bikhiaa ke pheeke taj chhode meree maai ||4||
lines.translation: The pleasures and adornments of corruption are insipid and useless; I have forsaken and abandoned them, O my Mother. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh taj gae piaare satigur charanee paai ||5||
lines.translation: Lust, anger and greed left me, O Beloved, when I fell at the Feet of the True Guru. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jo jan raate raam siu piaare anat na kaahoo jaai ||6||
lines.translation: Those humble beings who are imbued with the Lord, O Beloved, do not go anywhere else. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: har ras jinhee chaakhiaa piaare tripat rahe aaghaai ||7||
lines.translation: Those who have tasted the Lord's sublime essence, O Beloved, remain satisfied and satiated. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਚਲੁ ਗਹਿਆ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)chal gahiaa saadh kaa naanak bhai saagar paar paraai ||8||1||3||
lines.translation: One who grasps the Hem of the Gown of the Holy Saint, O Nanak, crosses over the terrible world-ocean. ||8||1||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਬ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran dukh kateeai piaare jab bhetai har raai ||1||
lines.translation: The pains of birth and death are removed, O Beloved, when the mortal meets with the Lord, the King. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)dar sughar sujaan prabh meraa jeevan daras dikhaai ||2||
lines.translation: God is so Beautiful, so Refined, so Wise - He is my very life! Reveal to me Your Darshan! ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬੀਛੁਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo jee tujh te beechhure piaare janam marahi bikh khaai ||3||
lines.translation: Those beings who are separated from You, O Beloved, are born only to die; they eat the poison of corruption. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jis too(n) melahi so milai piaare tis kai laagau paai ||4||
lines.translation: He alone meets You, whom You cause to meet, O Beloved; I fall at his feet. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jo sukh darasan pekhate piaare mukh te kahan na jaai ||5||
lines.translation: That happiness which one receives by beholding Your Darshan, O Beloved, cannot be described in words. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: saachee preet na tutaee piaare jug jug rahee samaai ||6||
lines.translation: True Love cannot be broken, O Beloved; throughout the ages, it remains. ||6||
